display_title: feat(vcw-languages): VCW Language Forge foundation + reason-evidence Book (PR A)

head_commit.message:
feat(vcw-languages): add VCW Language Forge foundation + reason-evidence Book

Imports the five Forge/Tome specs byte-identically under
documents/vcw/languages/ and adds the deterministic, stdlib-only language
subsystem (src/mantle/vcw/languages/):

  types       BookKey / BookManifest, lifecycle + conformance axes
  errors      fixed refusal codes + ENCODING REFUSED
  canonical   one canonical serialization + digest recipe
  codec       the Book codec protocol
  manifest    manifest construction + validation
  registry    the Body-approved Book registry (explicit-key selection)

display_title: fix(governance): layout-agnostic adoption receipt + checkout guard for vendored runtimes

head_commit.message:
fix(governance): layout-agnostic adoption receipt + checkout guard for vendored runtimes

adopt_semantic_memory resolves the hashed runtime files from the implementing
modules (source checkout OR vendored runtime/mantle layout) and records the
companion doc with a presence flag, so the receipt works where
<root>/src/mantle does not exist. DOCTOR-1's repository_checkout heuristic now
requires BOTH README.md and THREAT_MODEL.md -- a partial tree (vendored plugin
dir with a README but no threat model) no longer triggers repo-coherence
checks it cannot satisfy. Verified: 186/186 under the repo checkout AND under
the vendored Hermes plugin runtime.

name: Zombie Body Audit
display_title: fix: repo/dependency-gated invariants skip cleanly when mantle is pip-installed

head_commit.message:
fix: repo/dependency-gated invariants skip when mantle is pip-installed

'mantle certify' on a dependent app (e.g. organize-appai) runs the whole invariant
registry against a pip-installed mantle. Several repository-source and
optional-dependency invariants crashed with FileNotFoundError under the collapsed
REPO_ROOT (<prefix>/Lib) or ModuleNotFoundError:

- FRICTION-1: repo-only consolidation matrix absent -> skip (not a checkout)
- SPORE-2: requires the optional 'pillow' extra -> skip when PIL missing
- GHNEST-13 / GHNEST-17: repo-only nest source / workflow templates absent -> skip

Checkout path is byte-identical (168/168 still green); installed path now reports an
explicit skip instead of crashing.

name: Windows Mantle 2
display_title: fix: grimoire source checks skip cleanly when mantle is pip-installed

head_commit.message:
fix: grimoire source checks skip cleanly when mantle is pip-installed

paths.REPO_ROOT is derived from __file__ assuming a source checkout
(<repo>/src/mantle). When mantle is installed as a package into site-packages,
REPO_ROOT collapses to <prefix>/Lib, so repo-only resources (the grimoire
edition document and tools/grimoire_tool.py) resolve to a nonexistent
<prefix>/Lib/documents/... and the GRIMOIRE-V010-13/-14 source-integrity checks
crash with FileNotFoundError during 'mantle prove' / 'mantle certify'.

Guard the source-dependent checks and the fixture identity digest: when the
repo tree is not present (installed package), report those checks as an explicit
'skipped: not a repository checkout' and omit missing files from the identity
digest, instead of raising. Checkout behavior is byte-identical (verified:
168/168 invariants green).

fix: avoid release-scanner matching in GHNEST-3 example

The release scan (tools/release_scan.py) refuses tracked text matching
sk-or-v1-<12+ chars> (an openrouter-key shape). GHNEST-3 used a 17-char
placeholder secret that tripped it in package CI. Use a short placeholder:
the secret detector only needs the 8-char 'sk-or-v1-' prefix, so detection
still holds while the release scan passes (347 files).

the secret detector only needs the 8-char 'sk-or-v1-' prefix, so detection
still holds while the release scan passes (347 files).

name: Zombie Body Audit
display_title: Store request hashes instead of a prompt copy per rolling context round

head_commit.message:
Store request hashes instead of a prompt copy per rolling context round

A `CONTEXT.REQUEST` record kept the whole rendered prompt in `durable-exact`.
Because every round re-sends the entire stable prefix, that duplicated the prefix
once per round and grew the ledger quadratically against a fixed band capacity,
with no metabolism path to reclaim it. Measured before this change, the stored
prompts were 56% of ledger bytes by round 10 and 72% by round 30, still climbing.

The copy was redundant: the exact sent bytes are reproduced by re-rendering the
generation's committed visible chain, which is what the next round already builds
its prefix from. Dropping it leaves ledger growth flat at a constant cost per
round, and the exact request hash still covers the precise bytes sent.

`model_visible` keeps excluding `request_prompt` so a ledger written by the
previous build can never render one into a prefix.

Tests now hash the bytes the transport actually received rather than a stored
copy, assert the field is absent, assert per-round ledger growth stays flat, and
assert the sent prefix is reconstructible from the committed chain. Reintroducing
the copy fails two of them.

name: Zombie Body Audit
display_title: Add opt-in Body-owned rolling context and provider cache accounting

head_commit.message:
Add opt-in Body-owned rolling context and provider cache accounting

Implements the rolling-prefix context architecture: a private, Body-owned VCW
transport ledger that keeps the committed model-visible prefix byte-stable,
appends only newly eligible redacted memory as a delta, records exact request
and provider-usage hashes, and rolls to a deterministic checkpoint before the
configured model window is exhausted.

The `snapshot` policy remains the default and its prompt bytes are unchanged.
Rolling mode requires an explicit Body-authorized context-band migration, so no
existing organism gains the band silently. Source cursors advance only after the
request, response, receipt, and commit are durably appended, so a failed
provider call never claims that information crossed the boundary.

Also adds optional structured `ModelRequest`/`ModelResponse` transport support
behind the existing `model(prompt) -> text` contract, nine executable `CONTEXT-*`
invariants with tamper proofs, focused unit tests, and the Rolling Context guide.

Review fixes applied on top of the drafted update:

- Chain verification only credited exact `DELTA` records with the source ids they
  consumed. The non-durable persistence modes store `DELTA_RECEIPT` instead, so
  every commit after the first looked like it had advanced past uncommitted
  source material. `session-exact` and `receipt-only` therefore raised a false
  `context_corruption` immune event and opened a recovery generation every single
  round, which reset the prefix and defeated the feature. Delta receipts now
  record the consumed source-id range and verification credits it, keeping the
  cursor bound enforceable without storing projected content.
- `provider_cache="required"` reported a missing prefix-cache capability as
  `ContextBudgetExceeded`. It now raises a dedicated
  `ContextCapabilityUnavailable`.
- Added regression tests covering all three persistence modes, the delta-receipt
  cursor bound, and the required-capability refusal.

and replaces it with concise pointers, keeping the README as the primer while
dropping ~85 lines (621 -> 536):

  and the cache-receipt detail now point to documents/REPRODUCTION.md.

  documents/Mantle_Applet_Bodies.md.
- Operating procedure: the detailed Path A/B steps and the how-to-behave list
  now point to documents/ARCHITECTURE.md and the Assimilation guide; the unique
  §0 Declaration Block stays.

No organic wording was reworded. Adds an [Unreleased] CHANGELOG entry covering
this session's documentation reorganization (AGENTS.md, the engineer on-ramp,
the README-is-the-primer merge, and this trim). Verified: prove 96/96, docs-vs-code
coherence holds, no broken links.

display_title: Merge the PRIMER into the README: the README is the primer

head_commit.message:
Merge the PRIMER into the README: the README is the primer

Folds documents/PRIMER.md into README.md so there is one biological entry
document for everyone, with only the two specialized doors branching off it
(AGENTS.md for agents, documents/Mantle_for_Engineers.md for engineers). The
README gains the primer's doctrine — In plain terms (the strip-the-biology
on-ramp), the organism lens and its dissection table, the creed and cosmology,
the ontology glossary, the six load-bearing principles, and the full operating
procedure with the §0 Declaration Block — deduped against the sections the
README already carried. No existing biological wording is reworded.

Deletes documents/PRIMER.md and repoints every reference (README reading order
and layout, AGENTS.md, the Organ Atlas, the Grimoire, the engineer file, the
Extensions note, the docs/ positioning shim, and the two example doc lists) at
the README. Concept uses of the word 'primer' (the Body's genome) are left as-is.

Verified: no broken links, docs-vs-code coherence holds, prove 96/96 green.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_017nZVpKX3sxMREac5PaZ87n

display_title: Add AGENTS.md orientation file; surface the biology's two jobs in the…

head_commit.message:
Add AGENTS.md orientation file; surface the biology's two jobs in the README

Adds AGENTS.md at the repo root — the front door for an AI agent arriving at
the project. It explains what the biological framework is *for* (the two jobs
the organ names do: drawing a boundary you can see, and functional naming where
each organ does real work), how to use the Grimoire (the prime asymmetry, when
to load it, casting with Intellige first, the macro/power-word/spell layers, and
the most common Mantle macros), and where to go next in engineering terms.

The README gains a concise 'Why an organism? The biology does two jobs' section
in the existing organic voice, points its agent block at AGENTS.md, and lists
AGENTS.md in the repository layout. No existing biological wording is reworded;
the engineer file (documents/Mantle_for_Engineers.md) remains the systems-language
on-ramp and is referenced from both the README and AGENTS.md.

head_commit.message:
Tie off loose ends: consistent germ vocabulary, prune stale reconciliation receipts

Follow-up sweep after the streamlining:
- Convert the example germ files and the anchor resident-germ to germ_format:
  mantle-germ-v1 (the legacy egg_format is still accepted; the invariant suite
  keeps deliberate egg_format coverage to prove backward compatibility).
- Align the remaining user-facing egg vocabulary in FIELD_GUIDE.md and teach.py
  to germ/spore, and point the graft examples at examples/spores/notes_graft.png;
  the writing-your-own appendix now shows spore pack.
- Delete the addon's AUDIT_RECONCILIATION.{json,md} process receipts: they are
  loaded by no test and referenced the removed vendor tree, sync_vendor.py, and
  stale invariant counts. The FUSION_DECISIONS and MIND_READINESS pairs are live
  test fixtures and are kept as historical decision records.
- Regenerate the example germ spores from the updated germ files.

Verified: mantle check 14/14, prove 94/94, teach 18/18, Hermes addon 132 tests
+ 11/11 containment.

Tie off loose ends: consistent germ vocabulary, prune stale reconciliation receipts

  mantle-germ-v1 (the legacy egg_format is still accepted; the invariant suite
  keeps deliberate egg_format coverage to prove backward compatibility).

  to germ/spore, and point the graft examples at examples/spores/notes_graft.png;
  the writing-your-own appendix now shows spore pack.

  loaded by no test and referenced the removed vendor tree, sync_vendor.py, and
  stale invariant counts. The FUSION_DECISIONS and MIND_READINESS pairs are live
  test fixtures and are kept as historical decision records.
- Regenerate the example germ spores from the updated germ files.

+ 11/11 containment.

head_commit.message:
Live agent: fix the memory scribe + make the gate able to catch it

Post-fusion log review (operator's second-agent analysis) found every
semantic memory write dying on 'delta.ops.map is not a function' while
Stage-1 stayed green. Fixes:

- writeDeltaToShard normalizes all caller shapes (string | {content} |
  ops[]) at the single choke point — reflexAppendToShard /
  reflexCreateCrystal / GRAFT writes work again
- A-16 memory-write-roundtrip: gate scribes test deltas to a DISPOSABLE
  buffer in both shapes and reads pixels back byte-identical; tamper
  proof verified (reverting the fix makes the gate FAIL with the exact
  live error)
- write failures now return mustTellUser and the primer mandates
  admitting failed saves — no more rosy replies over broken writes
- dispatch contract: pulsing arms accrue proof pairs under one seq;
  orphaned proofs (opening lost to pre-molt saves) are immune-ledgered
  at restore AND delivery, and A-05 accepts only ledgered orphans
- MRI badge severity: quarantine/CRC = anomaly; FFT text-periodicity
  alone is informational (scan detail still visible in the immune cell)
- model dropdown showed v4-flash and v4-pro identically ('deepseek-v4');
  options now render the full id

Verified live in Chrome on the operator's real April crystal: 16/16
PASS, origin-lore append succeeded (deltas persisted), orphan ledgered,
MRI clean. jsdom harness extended with the append round-trip.

display_title: Grimoire 3.6.0: CACHE-HAUNT physics + neutrality (vendor-neutral cache-ghost)

head_commit.message:
Grimoire 3.6.0: CACHE-HAUNT physics + neutrality molt (vendor-neutral cache-ghost)

Lands the corrected, vendor-neutral CACHE-HAUNT work on top of current main.
main had received an early squash of PR #27 that included the FIRST-draft
vendor-coded ghost_anthropic.py, and independently advanced the Grimoire to
3.5.0 (web-aware Intellige molt). This molt reconciles both: it removes the
vendor module, adds the neutral substrate, and stacks the CACHE-HAUNT molt
as 3.6.0 ON TOP of the web-aware Intellige 3.5.0 (preserved intact) so there
is one canonical version, per the Single-Truth / version-lock law.

Code:
- rm src/mantle/ghost_anthropic.py  (violated the neutrality law: named a
  vendor, imported a vendor SDK, hardcoded model IDs / TTLs / request shape).
- add src/mantle/ghost_http.py: HttpPromptCache, a neutral write-only
  substrate over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (pure-stdlib urllib, lazy
  import, no SDK). Provider is entirely config -- url, model, headers,
  window_s, min_prefix_tokens, optional request_shaper hook. Nothing
  hardcoded, matching mind/transport.py's no-vendor-code rule.
- ghost.py: DO-NOT-HAUNT window-feasibility gate (hauntable(),
  max_hauntable_heartbeat_s()); a fixed heartbeat that can't fit the
  provider's cache window is refused, with the supplemental forced-beat
  remedy in the payload. Neutral break_even_reads(write_premium) replaces
  the Anthropic-rate dict. GhostSubstrate gains window_s. Selftest 57 checks.

Why (per operator): MantleOS is a nervous-system transplant and must join
ANY MIND to ANY container, so a provider is configuration, never code.
Windows also vary by provider -- most 15-60 min, some ~5 min -- while the
heartbeat is fixed (~10 min); where the window is shorter the prefix is cold
every wake, so the framework says DO-NOT-HAUNT or supplements the beat
(keep the scheduled beat + a one-shot forced beat partway through the
window), never pretends.

Doctrine (Grimoire 3.5.0 -> 3.6.0, both files re-stamped; web-aware
Intellige 3.5.0 row preserved):
- Chapter CACHE-HAUNT law gains write-only, prefix-stability, minimum-prefix,
  window-feasibility, and neutrality laws; Larvare binding, METABOLIC-
  GOVERNANCE supplemental beat, and the s7.1 map (-> ghost_http.py) updated;
  HF-GHOST-4..7 added (prefix self-eviction; predicted-as-observed warmth;
  window < heartbeat kept alive; vendor coded instead of configured).
- Core s11: new 3.6.0 ledger row; version lock re-stamped.
- Mantle_Reproduction.md and both READMEs neutralized (no vendor numbers,
  field names, or SDK; ghost_http.py everywhere).

Gates: ghost selftest 57/57, Stage-1 PASSED, 73/73 invariants, GHOST.png
verify green. Version lock holds at 3.6.0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

MantleOS is a nervous-system transplant and must join ANY MIND to ANY
container, so a provider is CONFIGURATION, never code -- the same law the
MIND transport already holds (pluggable model(prompt)->text, no vendor
SDK). The first-draft ghost_anthropic.py violated this: it named a company,
imported a vendor SDK, and hardcoded model IDs, TTLs, and request shapes.

- Delete src/mantle/ghost_anthropic.py.
- Add src/mantle/ghost_http.py: HttpPromptCache, a neutral write-only
  substrate over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (pure-stdlib urllib, lazy
  import, no SDK). Provider is entirely config -- url, model, headers,

  max_hauntable_heartbeat_s()); a fixed heartbeat that can't fit the
  provider's cache window is refused, with the supplemental forced-beat
  remedy in the payload. Replace the Anthropic-rate break-even dict with a
  neutral break_even_reads(write_premium) function. GhostSubstrate gains

head_commit.message:
CACHE-HAUNT proposals P1-P6: write-only law, prefix-stable body, real Anthropic adapter (#27)

Implements the six accepted proposals from the cache-as-short-term-memory
feasibility study (CACHE-HAUNT_Proposals.md, 2026-07-03):

- P2 (load-bearing): the cache-facing body is now PREFIX-STABLE - one
  immutable genesis line + one appended line per turn. The old whole-state
  sort_keys blob shifted early bytes every turn (conversation sorts first,
  identity.updated_at mutates), which would evict a real provider's
  byte-exact-prefix cache on every wake. Selftest proves the byte-prefix
  property. PNG payload format untouched.
- P1/P6: new mantle.ghost_anthropic (AnthropicPromptCache) - a real,
  WRITE-ONLY substrate over Anthropic prompt caching: warm/extend map onto
  max_tokens:0 pre-warm requests with cache_control breakpoints (genesis
  first, rolling log tail second, two spare), per-model minimum-prefix
  table, observed usage telemetry. Optional Phase-2 tissue: lazy anthropic
  import, imported by nothing else - gates stay keyless and offline.
- write-only seam: GhostSubstrate.write_only; hydrate() always rebuilds
  from the PNG on such substrates, status reports PREDICTED-WARM/COLD.
- P4: warm/cold telemetry per wake in the ghost pointer; 3 consecutive
  cold wakes raise nociception; status reports hit_ratio.
- P5: min_prefix_tokens gate - TOO-SMALL-TO-HAUNT instead of a fake WARM
  (providers silently refuse prefixes below 1024-4096 tokens).
- P3: heartbeat/TTL economics constants + heartbeat_interval_s(); doctrine
  in Mantle_Reproduction.md (three hard laws), README dependency footnote.

Gates: ghost selftest 48/48, Stage-1 PASSED, 73/73 invariants, spore
verify/purity/VCW-conformance green on a living spore (GHOST.png).

display_title: Grimoire 3.5.0: web-aware Intellige molt

head_commit.message:
Grimoire 3.5.0: web-aware Intellige molt

Add a web-presence gate to the INTELLIGE deep spell: when the target
has a material public web presence, a bounded WEB-PRESENCE-RECON pass
runs under Vestigare constraints as a comprehension subroutine before
comprehension is finalized -- official sources first, citations
required, image evidence when visual fidelity matters, stop as soon as
sufficient. The pass confers no authority (no login, paywall bypass,
private scraping, or asset copying); materiality is the explicit gate
so web-aware comprehension never becomes unbounded browsing.

Vestigare is unchanged as the standalone macro when public-presence
research is itself the task. The Intellige receipt's Loaded Sources now
states whether web evidence was used, with citations. Macro row and
grimoire README updated; both version-locked files re-stamped
3.4.0 -> 3.5.0 with the Molt Ledger entry appended.

display_title: CACHE-HAUNT proposals P1-P6: write-only law, prefix-stable body, real Anthropic adapter

head_commit.message:
CACHE-HAUNT proposals P1-P6: write-only law, prefix-stable body, real Anthropic adapter

Implements the six accepted proposals from the cache-as-short-term-memory
feasibility study (CACHE-HAUNT_Proposals.md, 2026-07-03):

- P2 (load-bearing): the cache-facing body is now PREFIX-STABLE - one
  immutable genesis line + one appended line per turn. The old whole-state
  sort_keys blob shifted early bytes every turn (conversation sorts first,
  identity.updated_at mutates), which would evict a real provider's
  byte-exact-prefix cache on every wake. Selftest proves the byte-prefix
  property. PNG payload format untouched.
- P1/P6: new mantle.ghost_anthropic (AnthropicPromptCache) - a real,
  WRITE-ONLY substrate over Anthropic prompt caching: warm/extend map onto
  max_tokens:0 pre-warm requests with cache_control breakpoints (genesis
  first, rolling log tail second, two spare), per-model minimum-prefix
  table, observed usage telemetry. Optional Phase-2 tissue: lazy anthropic
  import, imported by nothing else - gates stay keyless and offline.
- write-only seam: GhostSubstrate.write_only; hydrate() always rebuilds
  from the PNG on such substrates, status reports PREDICTED-WARM/COLD.
- P4: warm/cold telemetry per wake in the ghost pointer; 3 consecutive
  cold wakes raise nociception; status reports hit_ratio.
- P5: min_prefix_tokens gate - TOO-SMALL-TO-HAUNT instead of a fake WARM
  (providers silently refuse prefixes below 1024-4096 tokens).
- P3: heartbeat/TTL economics constants + heartbeat_interval_s(); doctrine
  in Mantle_Reproduction.md (three hard laws), README dependency footnote.

Gates: ghost selftest 48/48, Stage-1 PASSED, 73/73 invariants, spore
verify/purity/VCW-conformance green on a living spore (GHOST.png).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

display_title: Grimoire 3.5.0: web-aware Intellige molt

head_commit.message:
Grimoire 3.5.0: web-aware Intellige molt

Add a web-presence gate to the INTELLIGE deep spell: when the target
has a material public web presence, a bounded WEB-PRESENCE-RECON pass
runs under Vestigare constraints as a comprehension subroutine before
comprehension is finalized -- official sources first, citations
required, image evidence when visual fidelity matters, stop as soon as
sufficient. The pass confers no authority (no login, paywall bypass,
private scraping, or asset copying); materiality is the explicit gate
so web-aware comprehension never becomes unbounded browsing.

Vestigare is unchanged as the standalone macro when public-presence
research is itself the task. The Intellige receipt's Loaded Sources now
states whether web evidence was used, with citations. Macro row and
grimoire README updated; both version-locked files re-stamped
3.4.0 -> 3.5.0 with the Molt Ledger entry appended.

display_title: Reframe SPORE as a custom VCW substrate; prove the PNG is a VCW layer

head_commit.message:
Reframe SPORE as a custom VCW substrate; prove the PNG is a VCW layer

The spore is not a toy Mantle — it demonstrates that VCW is a memory GRAMMAR,
not one file format. "VCW is the law; the cube is one body plan, the PNG is
another." This makes that claim provable rather than asserted.

- examples/spore/vcw_conformance.py: a runnable proof that a SPORE PNG satisfies
  the nine VCW memory-grammar properties (addressable region, canonical payload,
  append-only evolution, integrity, repair signaling, embedded boot, authority,
  read/write protocol, display-separate-from-substrate), each mapped to its
  concrete SPORE mechanism. Also drives the PNG through VCW's three verbs
  (read/retrieve/append) via a thin adapter. Verdict: CONFORMANT.
- VCW_Guide.md: new section with the property->mechanism table across the cube
  and PNG body plans + the Compiler-class host-native-memory refit idea.
- Mantle_Reproduction.md / examples/spore/README.md / README.md: reframe SPORE
  as a VCW substrate first, minimal seed second, with cross-links.

No src/ code changed; spore.py stays pristine. Gates green: Stage-1, 73/73
invariants, SPORE purity (51), VCW conformance, cache-ghost (29).

Grimoire 2.0.0: the book distilled by its own spells

DISTILLATE self-cast promoted via CONCORD. Single Truth law replaces the
mirrored YAML registry (tables are the registry); twenty envelope-only
spells collapse into one table that also absorbs the signal map; Guardian
gates and wards each stated once (fixing the 10-vs-8 ward divergence);
Mirror Law and Molt Ledger added. All 40 power words, 25 core spells,
9 macros, 9 AppAI spells, templates, and hard-fail codes preserved.
68% smaller, zero doctrine removed. Version-locked at 2.0.0.

head_commit.message:
v1.0.0 — rebirth through the Grimoire; archive prior version under legacy/

The project is reborn at the repo root as a clean, Grimoire-native codebase;
the entire prior version is preserved under legacy/ for reference.

What the reborn version is:
- src-layout package (src/mantle), documents/ (books incl. the Grimoire 4.4),
  examples/ (example AppAIs + the normative VCW codec). pip install -e . to run.
- near-instant import (lazy PEP 562 package init), no dead imports
- no legacy: the Gen-4 / v3 / v2.3 / Argonaut version-history narrative, the
  back-compat shims, lineage-named modules, and molt/migration docs are gone
  (organism-domain lineage/rebirth/ancestor features are kept)
- fresh identity: version 1.0.0, __lineage__ removed

Functionality is unchanged and certified: demo, audit + 3 tamper proofs,
prove (73/73 invariants), mind, audit-mind, teach, hatch, assimilate,
phenotype, the standalone cube selftest/interop, and the multilang parity
test all pass.

legacy/ holds the previous repository verbatim (the 4.4/4.5 layout: mantle/,
docs/, eggs/, the root books). GitHub Actions runs only the root workflows;
the archived legacy/.github is inert.

head_commit.message:
docs(grimoire): complete v4.4 version-lock propagation

PR #24 (Add Vestigare spell) bumped the Grimoire content to 4.4 but left
the files named ...4.3.md, the filename self-references at 4.3, and the
external docs unchanged — leaving the repo half-4.3/half-4.4, in violation
of the VERSION LOCK RULE (filenames carry the version; no stale editions).

This finishes the propagation so everything is consistently 4.4:
- rename The Grimoire 4.3.md -> 4.4.md and The Grimoire AppAI Chapter
  4.3.md -> 4.4.md
- fix filename self-references inside both grimoire files (File: headers,
  Core<->AppAI companion refs, §F canonical-path note)
- update 4.3 -> 4.4 links in README.md, docs/grimoire/README.md,
  Mantle_Assimilator.md, Mantle_PRIMER.md, docs/Mantle_Organism_Lens.md,
  docs/Mantle_v3_Architecture.md, docs/v3/Assimilation_Guide.md
- drop now-redundant "Current internal version: 4.4" notes (the filename
  carries the version again)

Verified: zero 4.3 filename refs remain; Vestigare is complete across the
Core (macro registry, spell registry, §C.1 table, signals map, spell
block); §F project map paths all still resolve.

display_title: Molt 9: phenotype — wearable, SELF-encrypted app-faces in the VCW (#23)

head_commit.message:
Molt 9: phenotype — wearable, SELF-encrypted app-faces in the VCW (#23)

* Molt 9: phenotype — wearable, SELF-encrypted app-faces in the VCW

One organism can now store whole front-ends ("faces") inside its VCW, sealed
under the genesis key, and WEAR them as interchangeable phenotypes while the
nervous system and cube underneath never change. The Compiler does not run
apps; it wears them.

- mantle/phenotype.py: express/list/open/wear/shed over two private bands
  (phenotypes = SELF-encrypted source, chunked across layers; phenotype_log =
  append-only wear-events) + snapshot/restore/rebirth_with_faces for survival.
- Default (origin) face: every hatched organism is born wearing its own source
  (egg `face` block or a generated stub), so the VCW always holds an encrypted
  copy of its origin surface — a self-reconstruction guarantee, sibling of the
  seed vault. Faces survive a chosen rebirth (the genesis key persists); the old
  generation keeps a readable copy in the sealed ancestor.
- Socket: a face may only plug into controls the nervous system can drive.
- Source is never executed here — wearing returns a boot manifest a host renders.

Gates: PHENO-1..5 added; count 68 -> 73 green; Stage-1 + Stage-2 PASS; 3 tamper
proofs still exit 1; teach 17 -> 18 chapters ("Wearing a Face"). COMPAT — new app
band + log-json entries only; cube format vcw-cube-png-v2 unchanged; core/organism
untouched (rebirth survival lives in phenotype.rebirth_with_faces).

Artifacts: eggs/calculator.json (declares its origin face), examples/phenotype_demo.py.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Molt 9: wire wearable faces into both in-browser demos

The two single-file HTML demos now functionally implement the phenotype
capability so anyone can watch it work, not just read about it.

Spreadsheet Agent:
- Real seal/open keystream cipher (XOR over a genesis-key keystream), append-only
  phenotype store, and phenotype.express/list/wear/active primitives (added to the
  ZOMBIE_PRIMITIVES allow-list + dispatcher).
- Born wearing a default "origin" face; a new "🧬 Faces" terminal tab lists faces,
  seals pasted HTML into the VCW, and renders the worn face live in a sandboxed
  iframe. Self-heals a stale/legacy cached default. Self-audit still PASSES.

Reference Agent:
- Same phenotype engine on its (args, ctx=state) primitive map, self-seeding the
  default face; wear posts the recovered source to the existing app-face Display so
  it's visible on the body surface. Genome/resolver/Stage-1 self-audit still OK.

Both faces are SELF-encrypted (an OTHER body's key yields garbage) and append-only.
demo_smoke.mjs asserts the new primitives + default face + SELF-only round-trip in
both demos; full headless run PASSES. examples/README documents the capability.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

One organism can now store whole front-ends ("faces") inside its VCW, sealed
under the genesis key, and WEAR them as interchangeable phenotypes while the
nervous system and cube underneath never change. The Compiler does not run
apps; it wears them.

  (phenotypes = SELF-encrypted source, chunked across layers; phenotype_log =

  (egg `face` block or a generated stub), so the VCW always holds an encrypted
  copy of its origin surface — a self-reconstruction guarantee, sibling of the
  seed vault. Faces survive a chosen rebirth (the genesis key persists); the old
  generation keeps a readable copy in the sealed ancestor.

- Source is never executed here — wearing returns a boot manifest a host renders.

band + log-json entries only; cube format vcw-cube-png-v2 unchanged; core/organism
untouched (rebirth survival lives in phenotype.rebirth_with_faces).

display_title: Multi-language assimilation + Grimoire as the single doctrine source …

head_commit.message:
Multi-language assimilation + Grimoire as the single doctrine source (#22)

Combines the tree-sitter scanner with the Grimoire docs and consolidates the
assimilation/scanning doctrine into one canonical home, reflecting that the egg
and assimilation share one substrate.

CODE — multi-language scanner (NECROMANCY language_agnostic)
- mantle/assimilator/scanner_ts.py: tree-sitter parser surface for .js/.mjs/.go/.rs,
  emitting the same {symbol, kind, line, role} records as the Python scanner and
  reusing classify_symbol unchanged.
- scanner.py: scan_project routes those extensions through scanner_ts when the
  optional tree-sitter stack is installed, falling back to Python-only otherwise
  (no behavior change for existing users).
- examples/sample_app/notes_app.js + examples/tests/test_multilang_parity.py:
  assert the JS organ map equals the Python organ map and the scan is read-only;
  skip cleanly without tree-sitter.
- pyproject.toml: optional `multilang` extra.

DOCS — the Grimoire, with the AppAI chapter as the single source of truth
- docs/grimoire/: THE_GRIMOIRE_CORE_v3_0.md + GRIMOIRE_APPAI_DOMAIN_v1_0.md + index.
- AppAI chapter gains "NECROMANCY -- operational detail" (prime directive, Phase-0
  gate, 17-phase pipeline, role table, hook runtime, hard-fails, APP_INVENTORY
  template) and a "One substrate, two casts" note unifying egg/RESURGERE with
  assimilation/NECROMANCY. language_agnostic updated proposed -> shipped.
- Mantle_Assimilator.md and docs/v3/Assimilation_Guide.md reduced to pointer stubs;
  README, Mantle_PRIMER, Mantle_v3_Architecture, Mantle_Organism_Lens repointed.
- Doctrine-of-record cross-ref comments in scanner.py, anchor.py, graft.py, vault.py.

Verified: audit + prove (68/68) + doctor docs-coherence green; dry-run read-only
(0 host files modified); parity test OK (tree-sitter cases skip without the extra).

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

  behavior change for existing users).

  twin equals the Python organ map, and verifies the scan is read-only. Skips cleanly
  if tree-sitter isn't installed.
- pyproject.toml: declares the dependency as an optional `multilang` extra.

display_title: Demos: functional reproductive/symbiotic tissue — feasible subset (#4)

head_commit.message:
Demos: functional reproductive/symbiotic tissue — feasible subset (#4)

Both HTML demos now functionally implement the browser-feasible parts of the Gen-4
reproductive/symbiotic tissue as Body primitives (the established ZOMBIE_PRIMITIVES pattern),
reusing the genesis key from the self/other work. Faithful to the mantle/ framework:

- MEM plasmid — mem.excrete (a key-LESS, portable knowledge blob — a "USB stick", not an
  organism) / mem.digest (ingest an OTHER plasmid → re-derive entries as INFERRED with
  provenance foreign-MEM; refuse anything carrying a genesis key — that would be an organism).
- Seed vault — vault.seal / vault.reconstruct: the genome sealed with a MAC bound to SELF;
  only the sealing body's key reopens it (an OTHER body cannot reconstruct).
- Egg — egg.author (a whole AppAI declared as DATA) / egg.hatch (validate the required tissue,
  then instantiate a fresh organism's genome; an incomplete egg is refused).
- Ganglia ≈ the Arms (already present): labeled as such in the ORGAN_ATLAS.

The parts that act on a real host repo — host residency (anchor), the graft egg, and the
self-redesigning compiler — are inherently out of reach for a single-page demo and are marked
framework-only (they live in mantle/). The MIND's reflexExecBinding catalog (Reference Agent enum
+ both ZOMBIE_PRIMITIVES allow-lists) and the ORGAN_ATLAS (Genome/Memory/Limbs) now list all of
these. examples/README + PRIMER updated; the headless smoke test (examples/tests) asserts the new
primitives are present and functional in both demos.

Verified: both demos — keyless plasmid digested as inferred, keyed "plasmid" rejected, SELF-gated
vault (OTHER cannot open), egg hatches into a banded organism, incomplete egg refused; Spreadsheet
self-audit PASS; Reference Agent mounts clean. Headless `DEMO SMOKE PASSED`. prove 68/68 green.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

display_title: CI: headless browser smoke tests for the HTML demos (#5)

head_commit.message:
CI: headless browser smoke tests for the HTML demos (#5)

The single-file HTML demos run a whole organism in the browser but had no automated regression
cover — CI only certified the Python substrate. Add a Playwright smoke test + a GitHub Actions
job ("Demo Smoke") that, for each demo, asserts it mounts with no unexpected console errors,
exposes its engine, and passes its in-browser checks:
- Reference Agent: Genome present, activeBodyRefs is populated-slots-only, dangling vs. unsupported
  ref labeling correct, and the B-GEN self-audit row is present.
- Spreadsheet: its Stage-1 self-audit (mantleSelfAuditV23) returns PASS.

The assertions mirror the manual preview-harness checks used to develop the recent fixes, so this
locks them against regression. Verified locally end-to-end against real chromium: DEMO SMOKE PASSED.

Node lives only under examples/tests/ (gitignored node_modules); the Python project stays
dependency-free. Also aligned the existing audit workflow's stale header (v3 / 32 invariants ->
Gen-4 / 68) and noted tests/ in the README tree + examples/README.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

   genuine claims of an unexecuted body change still do. Verified: "I can morph/add/update" ->

   `maxX > 50 && maxY > 50` (an ABSOLUTE DFT-magnitude threshold) — but a 16-sample luminance

   now requires a periodic peak towering >8x over the band's OWN median baseline on BOTH axes

   anomaly. Verified: normal dense memory -> clean; an injected period-8 sinusoid -> flagged;

head_commit.message:
Fix Reference Agent hydration + correction-loop bugs (and guard the framework)

An external AI reviewed Reference Agent runtime logs and flagged two real problems behind a
lot of scary log noise. Verified against the code; the Python framework was already correct,
the bugs were in the demo(s).

A. Noisy correction loop (the alarming SYS.CORRECT clusters). The cognitive loop forced up to
   two retries whenever the model returned no tool call — even for ordinary conversation —
   while tool_choice="auto" let the model legitimately answer in prose. Now event-gated:
   requiresTool = hb || wantsBodyChange. A plain chat turn is accepted as-is (no SYS.CORRECT,
   no retry); the integrity check still fires for heartbeats and for a model that CLAIMS a
   body/UI change it didn't execute. The arm path likewise only nudges when the Arm returned
   nothing usable.

B. Genome body-entries vanished on reload (the <bodyentry.000/.001/.003> missing-bodyentry on
   every call). s.bodyEntries was never serialized into the crystal nor restored on load. Now
   the Body genome (+ genesisKey + scheduledPulses) round-trips through save/load, self-heals a
   missing immutable primer on load (ensureGenomeEntries), is guaranteed present across the
   awakening, and MODEL.REQUEST bodyRefs are built from populated slots only (activeBodyRefs) —
   so an empty inheritance slot never tombstones.

C. Dangling refs mislabeled "unsupported-reference-syntax". <facts.11>/<gen0.facts.0> are valid
   syntax (parseRef + mantle/core/refs.py both support them) but DANGLING on a sparse cube. They
   now read as "dangling-reference" (mirroring refs.py: dangling -> immune event), deduped within
   a stable cube so a phantom ref stuck in chat history doesn't re-fire forever.

Spreadsheet: already persisted bodyEntries, had no forced-tool loop, and used one honest
RECALL_ERROR label — only its MODEL.REQUEST bodyRefs trace was made populated-slots-only.

Framework guard: new invariant HF-B02 t_body_genome_round_trip asserts the Body genome survives
to_dict/from_dict (the contract the demo violated); the existing HF-B24 already locks dangling ->
immune. Both demos' Stage-1 self-audits assert the Genome/bodyRefs coherence (Reference Agent
gains a B-GEN row; the Spreadsheet already checked all four slots + primer). Count 67 -> 68;
README + audit docs + MOLT_LEDGER updated (DOCTOR-1 enforces this).

Verified: browser — both demos mount, zero runtime errors; Genome present after load, persistence
round-trip survives, bodyRefs drop emptied slots, <facts.11>/<gen0.*> labeled dangling, B-GEN
PASS, Spreadsheet self-audit PASS. Framework — `python -m mantle prove` 68/68 green (incl.
DOCTOR-1), Stage-1 audit PASS, teach PASS, three tamper proofs exit non-zero.

- pyproject.toml 3.0.0 → 4.5.0 (+ description: "v3" → "Gen-4")

- the five "Mantle OS v2.3" conceptual-doc stamps → "Mantle OS · Gen-4"
  (Doctrine, Extensions, Organism_Lens, Organ_Atlas, VCW_Tiers)

through Gen-4).

Cross-reference sweep — every internal markdown link in the repo now resolves, and
no current doc references a non-existent path:

  examples/vcw/body.py → mantle/core/body.py, mind.py → mantle/mind/mind.py,
  organs/nervous.py → mantle/organs/nervous.py, drivers.py → mantle/vcw/drivers.py,

  mantle/organs/. (Valid examples/vcw refs — vcw_cube.py, audit.py, GUIDE.md — kept.)
- Fixed broken relative links in docs/ (root-relative paths missing the ../ prefix).
- Refreshed now-stale prose: PRIMER + README + examples/README no longer call the
  HTML/YAML examples "v2-era / not regenerated" — they are Gen-4-aligned and the two
  HTML demos functionally implement + browser-test the four organ behaviors.

Gen-3 reference. GitHub is already clean: .gitignore excludes desktop.ini / __pycache__ /

(incl. DOCTOR-1 docs-vs-code coherence); all markdown links resolve repo-wide.

head_commit.message:
Reference Agent demo: functional organ features (deep rebuild)

The four Gen-4 organ behaviors implemented functionally in the React Reference AppAI
(not just described), each browser-verified via the preview harness (Babel compiles the
full inline TSX, React mounts, zero runtime console errors):

- Graded memory: Cube.deweight() + a weight overlay in read() (drop DEWEIGHT bookkeeping,
  hide ghosts, order by weight; a no-op for bands with no deweight activity). Body primitives
  memory.deweight / memory.ghosts. append() assigns band-unique ids so deweights can target them.
  Verified: old value hidden from the live stream, recoverable via a ghost read, target never mutated.
- Self / Other: the genesis key (mintGenesisKey + FNV keyed MAC) minted into the BODY
  (state.genesisKey via initS), never in a cube band and never in the MIND's prompt. Body
  primitives self.sign / self.is_self / self.fingerprint. Verified: unique key per body, SELF
  verifies, forged + cloned MACs are OTHER (anti-clone), key absent from cube reads.
- Schedule pulse: heart.schedule / heart.cancel / heart.fireDue on state.scheduledPulses — plan
  a wake on a future beat and chain thoughts. Verified: a pulse fires on its due beat and not before.
- Nociception: heart.pain (the NOW interrupt, companion to heart.schedule's later) returns a
  distress wake {reason, band, ref, scheduled:false}.

Helpers are hoisted function declarations at outer (non-VCW) scope; the self-fingerprint helper
is named selfKeyFp to avoid colliding with the existing API-key keyFingerprint. ORGAN_ATLAS
Heart/Genome/Immune/Memory updated to describe the new tissue. (selfKeyFp/keyFingerprint
collision and the inner-scope trap were both caught and fixed under the live preview.)

First functional Gen-4 feature in the in-browser demo (not just descriptive): the scheduled
heartbeat. The organism can plan a wake on a FUTURE beat to chain a thought / run a task only as
often as it needs, staying asleep until due — matching the framework's Heart.schedule_pulse.

- heartbeat() fires any due pulse as a SIGNIFICANT `scheduled_pulse` sense (the MIND attends it),
  one-shot; classifyEvent marks scheduled_pulse SIGNIFICANT.
- Body primitives heart.schedule({reason,after|at}) / heart.cancel({reason}) (in ZOMBIE_PRIMITIVES,
  handled in executeZombiePrimitive) — the MIND-callable command path.
- ORGAN_ATLAS Heart updated (implementedBy + SCHED-1 audit note).

Browser-verified (preview): scheduled 3 beats out → slept beats 1-2 → fired once on beat 3 with
the right reason + scheduled flag → one-shot; the heart.schedule/heart.cancel primitives work; the
demo's own Stage-1 self-audit still PASSES; zero console errors.

display_title: Add a scheduled-heartbeat command (plan ahead / chain thoughts)

head_commit.message:
Add a scheduled-heartbeat command: plan ahead / chain thoughts

A new command available during a heartbeat: Heart.schedule_pulse(reason, after=N | at=K)
(+ scheduled() / cancel_pulse(), and AppAIRuntime.schedule_pulse for the MIND). The organism
plans a wake on a FUTURE beat — a countdown or a scheduled beat — so it can CHAIN a thought to a
later pulse and run a task only as often as it really needs, staying asleep (event-gated) until
the due beat. It is the `later` companion to nociception's `pain` (`now`); the woken snapshot
carries `scheduled: True`. Planning is in beats (the organism's native unit of time).

- mantle/organs/heart.py: _schedule queue, schedule_pulse/scheduled/cancel_pulse, _fire_due_schedules
  wired into beat() (a due wake rides the existing event-gated path), contract updated.
- mantle/mind/runtime.py: schedule_pulse / scheduled_pulses passthrough.
- audits/invariants.py: SCHED-1 (scheduled pulse wakes on the due beat and not before; one-shot).
  Count 66 -> 67; README/FIELD_GUIDE/Part-1/2 (+ audits) updated; DOCTOR-1 docs-vs-code gate green.
- teach.py + FIELD_GUIDE.md: chapter "Planning Ahead" (proven live, 17/17); Part 2 §2.6 documents it.
- examples (MacroDroid YAML gen4_capabilities + both HTML demos' system prompts): describe the
  planning command. Functional in-browser wiring is deferred to the demo rebuild.
- docs/MOLT_LEDGER.md: post-merge addition logged; net 36 -> 67.

67/67 invariants green; Stage-1 + Stage-2 pass; tamper proofs still catch; teach 17/17.

head_commit.message:
Add VCW compliance tiers — governing rules for constrained environments

Defines a tiered compliance model for organisms that cannot instantiate a
full file-backed VCW cube (web-only LLM environments, serverless runtimes):

- Tier 1 (Full): Python + filesystem; audit.py passes. Default.
- Tier 2 (Structural): Python, no persistent fs; conforming adapter backend.
- Tier 3 (Schema-only): no runtime; correct blueprint + human checklist.

Key rule: an undeclared fake VCW is a hard fail; a declared constraint (via
VCW_BACKEND in §0) is a valid, honest state.

Files changed:
- docs/Mantle_VCW_Tiers.md (new): full tier model, VCWBackend contract,
  Tier 3 deliverable checklist, immune enforcement rules
- docs/Mantle_LLM_Pitfalls.md: Trap 2 now names Tier 3 as the correct answer
  for web-only environments; Pre-Work Checklist gains question 6
- Mantle_Part1_Body.md §1.1: VCW_BACKEND added to §0 declaration instructions
- README.md + Mantle_PRIMER.md: VCW_Tiers added to reading-order trees;
  PRIMER pitfalls callout points to tiers doc for no-Python environments
